recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed unless a future work group decision changes the operations framework wording.
issue_request: FHIR-18530 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification, applied for STU3, asking what "repository of resources" meant in the operations-page sentence "Operations may make use of the existing repository of resources in their definitions" and resolving to replace it with "Operations may make use of all types of resources existing in the repository."
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records Grahame Grieve's implementation note "git f7dd7bb655". Commit f7dd7bb6558b2c97b51f15820a999f6b6d2639c2 changed source/operations.html from the ambiguous phrase to the approved sentence, and pickaxe history shows that commit introducing the current wording.
additional_context: source/operations.html is the current FHIR-core Operations page: source/hierarchy.xml includes it as the Operations page and many current source pages link to operations.html. Current source/operations.html contains the approved sentence and no longer contains the old ambiguous phrase. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The build-scope source already matches the Jira resolution, so changing source would be redundant.
